craft_notes: Sthāyin: amṛta-śānta of quenched fever; maṅgala-śānta of pure treatise — the work lands in two breaths (nectar drunk, method pure). Colophon: method pure; rājñaḥ kept in-verse per UNC; scribal third-person excluded. Rejected: (a) naming author → killed: excluded as scribal. Read aloud: THIS-know-ing-BLISS ME-thod FOR-win-ning-ŚI-va … TREAT-ise PAST-pure.

lines: This knowing-bliss method for winning Śiva — great souls', Kṣema-named king's —
